therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PET radiotracer binding to amyloid plaques
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque load quantification in brain
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: older adults with late onset Alzheimer disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Relationship between cognitive change over time and amyloid (Aβ) deposition over up to 3 years and 10 months

results.effect_size: Beta weight (slope) = -0.034 (unitless; negative value indicates greater cognitive decline associated with amyloid positivity)
results.target_engagement_evidence: PET imaging confirmed amyloid-positive vs amyloid-negative classification; 41 participants with positive amyloid reading, 75 without
biomarker_changes: Amyloid-positive participants (n=41) showed greater cognitive decline over time compared to amyloid-negative participants (n=75) as measured by global cognitive Z-score
subgroup_findings: Amyloid-positive participants (n=41): greater cognitive decline (negative Beta weight = -0.034, p=0.02)
Amyloid-negative participants (n=75): less cognitive decline relative to amyloid-positive group
